The Bench

Nothing leaves the bench twice.

A piece is only cast once it has been carved, corrected, and worn in wax by the goldsmith who will finish it. There is no factory floor here — only one bench, one loupe, and the weeks it takes to get a clasp to sit right.

We work exclusively in recycled 18k gold and traceable stones, and every setting is signed on the inside — a mark you'll never see, made for you anyway.

  • — Hand-carved wax models, no digital casting shortcuts
  • — Stones set under a loupe, one prong at a time
  • — Every piece signed and dated inside the band or clasp
Lifetime Repolish
